# Evaluation batches

Generated by `scripts/make_test_batch.py` (fixed seeds) from real aerial photos in
VisDrone2019-DET-val (AISKYEYE team, Tianjin University; http://aiskyeye.com, licensed for
academic/research use). Images are downscaled to 768 px on the long side.

| split  | seed | role |
|--------|------|------|
| tuning | 1101 | threshold selection only |
| test   | 2202 | held out; scored once with frozen thresholds |

The splits come from disjoint VisDrone sequences. The ground truth sits in `<split>/ground_truth.json`, outside
`<split>/dataset/`, so detectors never read it. To regenerate:

```bash
python scripts/make_test_batch.py            # downloads the 82 MB source zip once to ~/.cache/cvtrust
python scripts/make_test_batch.py --source-zip /path/VisDrone2019-DET-val.zip
```
